# Request fidelity summary
#
# What each recorded *_request.xml loses when it round-trips through the
# library's request type via Registry[command].NewReq. Complements
# FIDELITY-SUMMARY.txt (which does the same for responses) and
# TestRequestGolden (which starts from curated Go values instead of
# recorded documents, and is the one that can catch a field the library
# silently fails to ever emit).
# Regenerate with: go test ./internal/gmptest -run TestRequestRoundTrip -update
